runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Marks the start of a conversational turn under session
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Preserve turnId so incremental text and terminal replies bind to the exact turn generation.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Informative progress indication that context has been hydrated into session memory
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Context is read-only positioning facts from Java; does NOT constrain model reasoning loop.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Informative progress disclosure of agent decomposition or intent
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Informative display hint; must NOT freeze or pre-bind model tool choices.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Dispatched when an authorized business tool begins execution
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Emitted only after budget checks and deduplication passes.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Tool executed and produced factual result
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Status is SUCCEEDED; output feeds back into model reasoning loop.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Tool failed or payload was clipped/truncated
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Status is FAILED; clipped results are explicitly non-success so UI never shows false all-success.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Execution pauses awaiting user approval on write action card
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Waiting state (kind: confirmation), NOT a terminal state; chat text cannot substitute for confirmation.
Must match active turnId; discarded if turn has already terminated.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Closed client UI directive (NAVIGATE, OPEN_MODAL, PREFILL_FORM, REFRESH_RESOURCE, FOCUS_ELEMENT)
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: Executed by frontend action dispatcher; reports terminal receipt asynchronously.

runtime_event_mappings.semantics: Terminal success with final grounded reply; endReason=COMPLETED, ok=true
runtime_event_mappings.projection_notes: endReason must be uppercase COMPLETED and ok must be true.
Cleans up incomplete streaming text; sets conversation status to failed.
User clicked stop or explicit cancel signal was received; distinct from mid-turn steer.

end_reasons.description: Natural model completion after fulfilling intent or tool operations
Explicit user cancellation via stop button (turn cancelled)
Session or daily token/call budget limit reached (distinct from general failure)
Model generation hit maximum output token cap (must NOT be disguised as COMPLETED)
Action or tool denied by scope, role, or policy
Unrecoverable runtime error, provider failure, or tool exception

interaction_states.description: Execution paused awaiting user approval or structured question answer; intermediate interactive state, NOT a finished turn

steer_semantics.description: request.steer injects guidance into an active running turn without terminating or resetting the turn

sequence_and_replay_rules.start: Persistent server events use 1-based sequential integers (sequence >= 1).
sequence_and_replay_rules.subscription: subscribeFrom=0 subscribes from the very first persistent event (sequence 1).
sequence_and_replay_rules.reconnection: Reconnecting clients supply Last-Event-ID with last acknowledged sequence; server excludes confirmed events and streams next.
sequence_and_replay_rules.boundaries: Snapshot hydration establishes clear replay bounds; streams are not assumed to always contain a synthetic initial event.

requirements.title: Strict Monotonic Sequence Identification
requirements.specification: Every persistent server-sent event must carry a monotonically increasing integer 'sequence' starting from 1 per conversation. Reconnecting client sends 'Last-Event-ID' with the last received sequence to replay missed events without duplicating side-effects.

requirements.title: Turn Generational Binding
requirements.specification: Every event belonging to a turn must carry 'turnId'. Content deltas from stale turns arriving late after a cancel or completed turn must be rejected by client using generational check.

requirements.title: Distinction Between Max Tokens and Completion
requirements.specification: The terminal event must provide a typed 'endReason'. 'MAX_TOKENS' and 'BUDGET_EXHAUSTED' must never be conflated with 'COMPLETED', and 'ok' must be false for non-completed terminal states.

requirements.title: Progress and UI Directive Branches (PROGRESS & UI_ACTION)
requirements.specification: MiniMax schema must include public branches for PROGRESS (progressKind: CONTEXT_LOADED | PLAN_GENERATED) and UI_ACTION (actionType: NAVIGATE | OPEN_MODAL | PREFILL_FORM | REFRESH_RESOURCE | FOCUS_ELEMENT) so client directives and progress hints can be typechecked without polluting content.delta.

requirements.title: Typed Question and Confirmation Payloads in INTERACTION_REQUIRED
requirements.specification: INTERACTION_REQUIRED must provide structured question data (questionId, text, options) or confirmation data (actionId, preview, expectedVersion) so frontend can render actionable cards rather than unrendered empty payloads.

requirements.title: Ephemerality of Secrets and Clean Boundary
requirements.specification: The Runtime event stream must NEVER contain API keys, raw bearer tokens, database passwords, or local file system paths. Sanitized errors only.
